cands.name: Laura Hall

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 19 since winning a 1993 special election. Retired educator with over forty years in education, including teaching at J.O. Johnson High School and administrating at Calhoun Community College. Lost a 2009 special election for state Senate District 7.

endorsements.text: Listed as endorsed or recommended in 2026 by the voter guides Tabitha's List: Candidates You Can Trust and Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy (Sway voting groups).

cands.gaps: We could not find when Laura Hall moved to Alabama or what brought her here. We found no documented actions on the issues in this guide (data centers, homestead taxes, land buying, growth, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion, school choice) beyond a list of bills she sponsored, such as Silver Alerts, Rosa Parks Day and a newborn safe-haven policy. We found no statements from her on these issues, since she did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys. We found no documented stances on data centers or development, no controversies and no foreign ties.

cands.bio: Republican candidate for Alabama House District 19 in 2026. He ran against incumbent Laura Hall (D). No career or prior offices held are documented in the sources found.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Donald Barnes was born or raised, when he moved to Alabama, or what his career has been. He has not held public office that we could find. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and his campaign website lists no policy positions beyond saying he supports the Alabama Republican Party Platform. We found no statements from him on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing, and no news coverage or documented controversies. No endorsements were found.
